Dialogs.Dialog: I found a little flower bed behind the school today. Nobody seems to care for it, so I might water it mornings.
If you want, ● can help out too.
Are you sure？ In that case, could you help for a week？ I'll ask the school to take proper care of it by then.
I don't mind at all. Let's do this together.
...It might be tough, but good luck.
Yeah... It was withering and I felt so bad for it, so I want to look after it until it blooms.
I see. I'll be rooting for you.
Come to think of it, I'm supposed to tend to the flowers with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Guess I'm tending the flowers with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ today, too...
Today makes one week! Thanks for watering them with me all this time.
Yep! I went and talked to the school, so the greening committee is taking over now.
I see. A part of me's a bit sad, but... that's good.
Was watering every day too much after all？
It's okay. I'm the one who brought it up anyway.
If anything else comes up... I promise I'll help next time.
Hold on! Ah... no, not it.
Sorry for startling you. I kind of dropped my eraser. I've been looking for it, but I can't find it anywhere.
Want me to help you look？
● can help you look, too. What kind of eraser is it？
Well... it's tanuki-shaped... and it's still brand new. Maybe I didn't drop it here.
A tanuki, huh... Got it. I'll pick it up if I see it.
Sorry about this. Only if you happen to find it, okay？ Don't go out of your way.
If you can't find it anywhere, maybe you should give up...
You're right... I've searched this much with no luck. I should probably give up...
(Was it a really special eraser to her？)
(Come to think of it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was looking for an eraser... Maybe I'll check around.)
Is this it, by any chance？
Yes, that's it! What a relief.
Heh, did you really like it that much？
Uh... yeah. Besides, you have to take care of your things, right？ Anyway, thank you.
By the way, did you ever find that tanuki eraser？
I see... Sorry ● couldn't help either.
Don't worry about that. Thanks for helping me look.
We're in a bit of a bind. Apparently someone called out tomorrow last-minute.
If you're okay with it, should ● cover tomorrow？
Really？ In that case, could I ask you to？ I'm counting on you!
Calling out last minute... Tomorrow's definitely gonna be rough.
Yeah... I guess if we all pitch in, we'll manage somehow.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'ll be there too, so I'm sure it'll be fine.
(Come to think of it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ asked me to cover a shift today...)
(Right, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ asked me to cover a shift today...)
Taking my time should be fine
Sorry about today. You really saved me out there, thank you!
Hey, we help each other out when we're in a pinch.
In that case, will you help me out next time I'm in a pinch, too？
I was waiting for you yesterday... Did you forget about work？
We managed, so it's fine, but if you couldn't make it, I wish you'd let me know.
Have you seen any movies lately, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Movies... Oh! I forgot the due date on my DVD!
No time to watch it today, so tomorrow night, but going at night is scary... Should I just return it unwatched？
Want me to go with you？
In that case, want me to come along when you return it tomorrow night？
It's no trouble at all. I head out to the convenience store at night anyway.
Are you really sure you don't mind coming？
Thank you. In that case, I'll take you up on it.
Isn't returning it unwatched a waste？ Why not just pay the late fee？
You're right... That's probably better than renting it again.
(I was supposed to go with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ to return that DVD...)
Sorry for dragging you along for such a hassle.
Thanks to you, I could watch the DVD and return it on time. You really saved me!
I'll have to think of a way to thank you.
Don't worry about it. You can ask me anytime for this kind of thing.
Really？ If you say so... Thank you.
Yesterday I ended up returning the DVD all by myself, you know？ And I was counting on you, too.
Though I guess it's my fault for forgetting the due date in the first place. My bad!
(When she apologizes... it actually hurts worse.)
Ah, trash... Even though there's a bin right here.
You're right... Maybe I'll make this week "Clean-up Week." I can pick up trash around Dixie's before my shift. What do you think？
That sounds great. Maybe I'll join in with you, ●.
Are you sure you want to say that？ It's every day for a whole week, you know？
I'm glad. To be honest, doing it all alone felt a little lonely.
All right, let's do this together!
You really always work so hard, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
You think so？ I'm coming in for work anyway, so it's really no big deal if I do it then.
I'm sure everyone will really appreciate it.
(Come to think of it, I'm supposed to pick up trash with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
(Picking up trash with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ again today...)
The usual time should be fine
I have time for a quick detour
Today's the last day of Clean-up Week, huh.
Right, it's already been a week.
You did a great job! Thanks for all your hard work this week.
Still... now that it's over, it feels a little lonely. I hope we can team up again.
We couldn't finish Clean-up Week together after all, huh.
Yeah... Sorry I couldn't keep my promise.
For this time, it's the thought that counts. Knowing you wanted to do it together was enough.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Wait, is something on your mind？
Ah... Yeah. My homeroom teacher asked me to make some handouts, but there's just so much.
●'ll help too. They shouldn't be dumping this on students anyway.
Thanks! Sorry about this, but you're a real lifesaver.
What should we do？ Do you want to start now？
Um... let's do it tomorrow, then. Can you come by my classroom？
(Oh right, I was supposed to help ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ with that paperwork...)
All done! Seriously, thank you so much.
That actually didn't take long together. Would've been rough on your own, though...
You really saved me. I'm so relieved...
I was waiting for you, you know. In my classroom.
Ah! The paperwork... I'm so sorry!
It's fine. It was my job in the first place, anyway.
Working hard at your job, huh？ How about some special, limited-time customer service training from yours truly？
You asked for it! We'll train before your shifts for a while. I won't go easy on you, so be ready, okay？
I think I'll pass on that...
Oh？ Well, fair enough. Maybe I was being a bit bossy, offering to train you...
(Oh right, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was going to train me in customer service...)
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s training me in customer service today, too...)
I have time for a quick detour
Good work! I think you've really gotten the hang of it.
I think I've gotten more confident myself. It's all thanks to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
That wraps up our training! If you ever have questions, feel free to ask anytime.
Yeah, thanks. I'll be counting on you again.
Guess your customer service didn't improve all that much...
Sorry... I guess ● didn't try hard enough.
Mm... nah, you can always learn on the job. Keep giving it your best, okay？
In the morning, I always end up falling back asleep.
Oversleeping？ Then how about I text you every morning, and you have to reply to it？
Replying by text, huh？ That might actually work.
Right？ Keep it up a week, and I bet you'll kick that habit of falling back asleep.
Yeah. But won't texting every morning be a pain for you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
I don't mind at all！ Besides, knowing I have to text you will help me wake up, too.
Then do you mind if I take you up on that？
All right, deal！ Let's both do our best for a week, starting tomorrow.
Honestly, it sounds like kind of a hassle...
I see... Well, mornings are pretty hectic for me, too...
Thanks for looking out for me, though.
(Oh, right, I'm supposed to reply to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s text...)
(Right, need to reply to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s text...)
You kept it up for a whole week. Good job！
Yeah. I feel like I finally got in the habit of waking up on the first try.
Knowing I had to get up early gave me plenty of extra time in the morning, too♪
Hearing you say that is a big relief, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
In return, you have to help me out if I ever want wake-up texts, okay？
Looks like you couldn't keep up with the replies...
...Maybe my idea wasn't that great after all？
No, that's not it. You went out of your way to help me, and... I'm sorry.
I wonder if there's a good trick to memorizing the whole menu...
Hmm, maybe learning it by category would work...？
If you're nervous, I can help you study. I'll text you a category, and you reply with the items. How's that sound？
Quizzing by text, huh？ All right, I'll give it a shot.
That's the spirit！ I like your enthusiasm.
That's a bit... I think I'll pass.
Yeah, true... It'd be kind of a hassle.
I'd feel bad putting you out, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... I'll do my best on my own.
(Oh right, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was going to help me learn the menu over text...)
(Right, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ offered to help me learn the menu over text...)
You did great with our menu training over text！
Hehe... You passed！ Looks like you really got them all down.
Whew, what a relief. I only managed because you helped me out, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Now that you know it all, make sure you don't forget, okay？
About that menu-memorizing training by text...
Unfortunately, looks like you didn't try quite hard enough.
After you helped me and all... I'm sorry.
We're dog-sitting for our neighbor at my place. Just four days and three nights while they're away.
It's a really cute little dog, but walking it after work and all... I'm a little worried about taking care of everything.
I can come on walks with you
If it's for walks, ● can come along too.
Oh no... I'd feel bad asking that of you.
Don't worry about it. I'd worry more about a girl walking alone at night anyway.
Treating me like a girl, are you？ Hehe... But I won't be alone. The doggy will be with me.
A tiny dog isn't gonna be much of a bodyguard, you know.
True. In that case, maybe I'll take you up on that for the three days？
You don't need to worry so much, it'll work out.
You're right... I agreed to do it, so I have to pull myself together.
I think ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'ll do just fine.
(Come to think of it, I promised to walk the dog ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is watching...)
(Guess I'll go with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ to walk the dog again today...)
It really is reassuring having a guy with me. Thanks for walking with me all three days.
Oh right, the owners are already coming back, huh？
Yeah. Aww, I'm gonna miss it... I wish we could stay together a little longer.
Still... I'm sure the pup will be happier going back to its owners.
I guess coming along for walks was a chore after all, huh？
It was wrong of me to rely on others to help take care of the dog... Don't worry about it.
(...Wonder if I'll get a chance to redeem myself？)
Starting tomorrow, we're short-staffed for three days, right？ So why don't we go to work together to make sure we're definitely not late？
We don't need to go that far...
Yeah, sure. Come to think of it, the manager was saying scheduling was tough.
Yeah. Then I'll come pick you up starting tomorrow.
Don't you think we'll be fine without going that far？
Mm... You're right. Maybe I was overthinking it.
Don't worry, everyone'll show up for work on time.
(Come to think of it, I'm heading to work together with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
(Guess I'll head to work with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ again today...)
We somehow made it through those three days, huh？ Great job out there.
Good work to you too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. I felt way more fired up than usual these past three days.
Is that why you looked even more manly than usual？
Did you forget our promise... to head into work together？
Don't give me 'uh...'! When you make a promise, you have to keep it, okay？
Do you always remember to do your homework？
Oh, jeez. How about for a week, I text you each night to check, and you reply back to me？
Sounds good! Are you really sure, though？
Yep. That way, I won't end up dozing off and forgetting mine either, right？
I see, so it helps both of us out.
Exactly. Let's give it a try for a week.
(A promise, huh... Makes my heart beat a little.)
No way, that won't work... If I'm asleep, I won't even notice your text.
Hmm... Yeah, fair point. I'll let you know if I come up with a better idea, okay？
(Oh right, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ said she'd text to check on my homework...)
So, the homework texts. How did that week feel？
Thanks to you, I didn't forget once. Total lifesaver.
Glad to hear it. I totally nailed all my prep and review this week, too.
Though you always seem so perfect anyway, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Not at all. Mind if I ask you to do this kind of thing again from time to time？
Of course! The pleasure's all mine.
Did my homework check-in texts... not help after all？
Then I really wish you'd kept your promise to reply...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you've got kind of a troubled look on your face？
Actually, they asked me to come up with new menu ideas again... But I haven't eaten out much, so I'm drawing a total blank.
Let's go eat out together again
Then why don't we go check out some food places together again？
Huh... together？ Wouldn't that just be a hassle for you？
Not at all! I live alone, so eating out all the time is no problem for me.
Really？ Thank you! Then I think I'll take you up on that.
Go right ahead, don't hold back.
Looks like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ has her hands full as usual...
It feels nice being relied on, though... so I just have to do my best, right？
I'll be rooting for you from the sidelines.
Come to think of it, I was supposed to go eat with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Right, I was supposed to go eat with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Thanks for coming out to eat with me.
Not at all, I had a great time too.
I found some new flavors, too, so I think good ideas will start coming to me♪
Will you help me out again if anything else comes up？
You said you'd go out to eat with me... I was really counting on you, you know.
It looks like I'll manage this time, so it's okay, but... breaking promises isn't nice, you know？
Yeah... I feel really bad about it.
How've things been lately？ You haven't been taking on too much work, have you？
Well, you see... When I pitched the new menu ideas, they asked if I could make prototypes. And within a week, too.
That sounds rough. If it's okay with you, ●, I'll help out.
...If you say that, I might actually take you up on it, you know？
Of course, I don't mind at all.
That'd be such a help... In that case, would you be willing to taste-test every day for a week？
Taste-testing...？ Is that really all you need？
Rather than eating what I made myself, I think seeing someone else's reaction gives a much better sense of how it turned out.
That's a big responsibility. I'll give it my all!
They sure asked a lot of you again...
Making prototypes is fun, but with a one-week deadline, it's quite a bit of pressure. I hope it goes well...
You'll do great, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Hang in there.
Come to think of it, I was supposed to taste-test ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s prototypes...
Right, I was supposed to taste-test ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s prototypes...
Yep, even I'm satisfied with how this turned out! This just might work♪
Feels like the culmination of all ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s hard work.
I only made it this far thanks to you. Thank you so much for sticking with me all week.
Well, ● got to eat tons of delicious food, so I was pretty lucky.
Next time you help me out, maybe I'll make you a nice home-cooked meal as thanks？
Really？ In that case, I'd love that.
Did you really not want to help with the recipes？
It's not that, it's just... things came up and I kind of missed my chance to go.
Hmm... So it's not that you didn't want to eat my cooking, then？
Yeah, I'm really sorry... I feel bad about it.
Hey, right before bed, don't you ever feel like saying good night to someone？
Hmm, yeah, I guess I kind of get that.
...Then could you text me good night every day？ Not forever, just... for a week, to start.
Are you really sure it's okay if I text you？
Of course！ I'll really be waiting, okay？
'Good night' is just such a nice way to wrap up the day, don't you think？♪
I don't know about that... If I forget, I'd end up keeping ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ waiting.
Hmm... That's true, too. It's not like we always go to sleep at the same time...
Come to think of it, I'm supposed to send ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ a good-night text...
Right, gotta text ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ good night...
Yeah, I actually had a lot of fun doing it.
Fufu, I loved waiting for your texts every night, too.
Were the good-night texts that boring to you？
Hmph... And here I was, actually looking forward to them.
(Oh, is that ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ Wonder if it's okay to call out to her.)
(...Maybe I'll try calling her something different. Last name, first name, with -san, with -chan...)
Are you alone？ If you'd like, you could come with ●...
Ah... Sorry, I'm kind of in a rush right now. See you！
(She turned me down, but I wonder if calling her that was okay.)
(Was calling her that a bad idea？)
If you're on your own, mind if I walk with you？
(Looks like calling her that was totally fine.)
(...Guess calling her that is a no-go.)
Since we're both here, let's go together.
（Looks like that name worked after all.）
Hmm, what to do？ ...Just kidding. Let's go♪
（Looks like that name worked after all.）
Since we ran into each other, wanna walk together？
Well, can't say no to you. Sure.
（Looks like that name worked after all.）
Well, I kind of needed to see someone I know...
Oh, really？ Sorry for stopping you. See you later.
Um, I actually needed to see ▲高嶺＊＊▲, but...
Oh... Did I interrupt something？ Bye-bye.
Um, I actually needed to see ▲小早川＊▲, but...
Oh, um... I actually needed to talk to you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Wow, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, your explanation was really easy to follow.
Glad I could help. See you later, then.
（She's already gone... Guess it can't be helped.）
Um... maybe you shouldn't let your eyes wander？ See you later.
I was just on my way back to the classroom.
I see. You'd better get back quickly, then.
I couldn't help calling out, but were you in the middle of something？
Oh, really？ Sorry to interrupt, then. See you later.
Aw... So it wasn't me？ Too bad.
Good timing... I actually needed to see ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
If there's anything else you want to ask, anytime! See you later.
Huh...？ Sorry, I'm in a bit of a rush.
I was just thinking I should head back to class soon...
I see. Maybe I'll head back too, then.
(I was actually planning to talk to ▲高嶺＊＊▲, though...)
(I was actually planning to talk to ▲小早川＊▲, though...)
You startled me... Oh, it's just ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Aw, you make it sound like you're disappointed it's me... That hurts.
I just needed to see someone I know, so...
Ah, I see. I'll make myself scarce, then.
I had something to take care of with someone I know...
Guess I'm in the way, then... Too bad, but I'll catch you another time.
Sorry, after you went through the trouble of saying hi.
Geez, you should've just told me that sooner! What's up？
Thanks, that was a big help.
You're welcome. Well, I'll be on my way!
(No way she's still around by now, though...)
Geez, don't shout like that... Won't you get in trouble if someone hears？ See you.
I've got somewhere to be, so...
Oh, really？ Sorry for holding you up.
Talk to me next time, okay？ See ya!
(Huh... Did I lose track of ▲高嶺＊＊▲？)
(Huh... Did I lose track of ▲小早川＊▲？)
(Wonder if it's okay to call out to her？)
What do you mean 'what's up'？ I just saw you. Am I not allowed to say hi？
Not at all, I just had something to take care of with someone I know...
Oh, so I'm in the way... Sorry about that. Well, I'll be going now.
(Man, now I made her feel awkward...)
I was just about to go talk to someone I know, so...
No business with me, then？ Just kidding... Sorry for holding you up. Catch you later!
Good timing, actually. There was something I wanted to ask you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Is that so？ What is it？
Thanks, that's all I needed to know.
Whenever you need a hand, just ask♪ Well, I'm off.
(I wonder if ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is still around...？)
(I wonder if ▲小早川＊▲ is still around...？)
(Wait up for me...？ No way, right.)
Hey now... Don't shout so loud. If it's important, I'll hear you out later, okay？
(Huh... Did I bother her or something？)
I'm glad you stopped me, but... I really have to get back to class.
Already？ Well then... Let's chat properly next time, okay？
I'm so sorry, are you okay！？ Wait, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！
Yeah, I seem to be fine. I'm in a rush too, though... See you later.
As long as you're really okay...
...Ah, I'm fine. I wasn't paying attention either, sorry, okay？ Bye.
I'm glad ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ wasn't hurt... Well, see you.
Anyway, I'm in a rush right now, sorry! Later!
Ah... I should be the one apologizing. See you.
I'm sorry too. Come on, we'd better hurry.
Um... yeah. ...I need to hurry, okay？ See you.
Excuse me, didn't you drop this？
I knew it was you. I thought so from behind, actually.
You're very welcome. Well, I've got to get going. See you later.
Thanks for picking that up, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. You saved me.
Hehe, you have to pay better attention, okay？
Good boy♪ Well, see you later.
(She's older than me, but ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is so cute...)
Ah, sorry. I was spacing out.
Here. You've gotta stay sharp, okay？ See you.
Sorry, I was kind of spacing out.
You really saved me, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Thanks.
Don't mention it. I'm in a rush though, so I'll be going.
Right, ● has to get going too! See you.
(The next classroom was this way, right？)
I just happened to spot you, so...
Was ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s classroom over this way？
No, I have to change rooms for next period. Ah... I should get going.
Yeah. We don't usually, but we have to today.
Huh, so it really was just a coincidence.
Hehe, I guess so. Well, I've gotta run. Bye-bye.
Oh, really？ Ah... sorry, though. ●'s in a rush.
I see... Well, see you later.
(She spotted me and went out of her way to say hi...)
Ah... right, ● needs to head to the next class.
Uh... weren't you on your way somewhere, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Ah, right! That's it... Well, I'll get going.
(What was that？ Panicking all of a sudden...)
Here you go. You dropped this, right？
Thank you. I'm in a rush, so see you later.
Oh, here. You dropped this, didn't you？
I would've walked off without even noticing. Thank you.
You're welcome. Didn't expect it to be you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Would you rather it was another girl？ Hehe... Well, I should get going.
(Not to compare her to other girls, but ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ really is gorgeous...)
Ah... um, here. You dropped this.
Thank you. Well, I'm in a hurry, so I've gotta run.
Yeah... Ah, I've gotta go. Um... thank you.
Is there... something on my face？
Come on, don't just space out like that.
This is... a little close, don't you think？
You didn't have to back off that far, you know.
Ah... you backed away on purpose just now, didn't you？
Aren't you gonna come... any closer？
(I got a little carried away there...)
(Running into each other by chance is pretty nice.)
I knew you could do it.
Yep, just as I expected. Never doubted you.
Hehe, of course you'd pull something like that off.
You worked so hard! Good boy, good boy.
That's right... You really are dependable.
Thinking 'naturally'？ Look at you, Mr. Cool.
Wasn't it tough？ You really hung in there.
You'll be fine, you'll be fine.
You don't need to worry so much, okay？
It's not something you need to fret over that much anyway.
You're a strong boy, right？ So you'll be just fine.
Yeah, it couldn't be helped, can't be helped.
Don't let it get you down... okay？
Come on now, no sulking! You've got this!
Want some comfort？ I'll let you lean on me for just a little bit.
Hey, hey, what're you gonna do？
Mm, I think you should just make the call yourself.
What are you planning to do？ Of course... right？
Don't push yourself too hard, okay？
In that case, you'd better give it your all.
I knew you could do it.
That's true. No point pushing yourself too hard.
How've things been in the tennis club lately？ Working hard？
Pretty good, I guess. We're not that strict, so it's just fun.
Hm？ Interested in club activities, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Ah, no, no. That's impossible with my job. I wouldn't be able to juggle both.
Well... don't the guys and girls in the tennis club look like they get along really well？
Well, yeah, pretty much. Everyone gets along great.
●... I don't know. I don't think I'm that close, though...
I see... Then that's fine, I guess？
Hey, can I ask you something？
What's the library committee like？ You know, between the members.
Well... It's not like everyone interacts that much.
Is that so. Do you have anyone... you're close with？
Huh？ Well... yeah, there are girls too.
Maybe I'll go take a peek at the library sometime.
You're always welcome to, but... is something on your mind？
No, just talking to myself. Don't worry about it.
How are you doing in class？ Do you have friends you're close with？
I see. You're like that at Dixie's too. I guess you make friends pretty easily.
I don't know. I wouldn't say I'm that outgoing.
That's not true. I think you're really easy to get along with.
Really？ Well, I'm glad to hear that.
Hmm, I wonder if you're popular with the girls, too...
Hmm？ I didn't say a thing？
You live on your own, right？ What's that like？
Pretty carefree, honestly. I just do whatever I want.
Oh？ And you've got housework all handled？
Ah, hehe. So not quite, huh.
Haha, yeah. Sure wish someone would help me out, though.
Geez, say things like that and I might actually come over, you know？
I'd love that, but... I'd feel bad making you.
You shouldn't feel bad, but... no, you're right.
